review_notes: I read all 200 lines of the target file. It has no @[simp] attributes, no simp sets, no custom simp lemmas, and no definitions that simp would unfold. All its simp use is `simpa only [...]` with explicit lemma lists (`one_mul`, `sq_abs`, `uIcc_of_le`). That use is stable and cannot loop. The lemmas are inequalities (the AM-GM ratio bounds, the Jensen-type integral bound, and the transport bound). They are also integrability facts and one interval-integral substitution identity, `midpoint_quantile_substitution`. That identity needs positivity hypotheses and a two-quantile midpoint integrand. It has no canonical shape that a default simp set would reach, and it is not a good simp rewrite. Tagging any of these lemmas @[simp] would lack a canonical normal form and could not discharge its side conditions. I did not inspect the imported FacetQuantile, InteriorQuantile or QuantileCentroid files for simp rules on `quantile` or `velocity`. Those would be outside this file. I found no concrete, supported simp-interface defect here.
